summary: axiom project environments is now axiom project sandboxes, and its --environment option is now --sandbox. The commands call the moved sandbox API under /api/v1/projects/{project_slug}/sandboxes; /environments/{environment_id} is reserved for configuration environments (deployments) and today answers AXSANDBOX_MOVED. The old name fails before any request with exit status 2 and 'axiom project environments was renamed to axiom project sandboxes'. CLI 0.153.0 and older cannot manage sandboxes any more: each axiom project environments command fails on its first sandbox request with 'AXSANDBOX_MOVED: Not found: The sandbox API has moved. Reload the dashboard, or install the current Axiom CLI and use axiom project sandboxes. (HTTP 404)', and reset and delete fail at their lookup, before any change. Against a server from before the move (for example after a rollback), this CLI prints 'the server predates this CLI; install CLI 0.153.0' with the install command. Dashboard tabs opened before the switch run the old page code until reloaded: their Sandbox page shows the server message 'The sandbox API has moved. Reload the dashboard, or install the current Axiom CLI and use `axiom project sandboxes`.', and their Tests page silently lists no sandboxes. Reloading the tab fixes both.
migration: Replace axiom project environments with axiom project sandboxes and --environment with --sandbox in scripts; treat exit status 2 from the old name as a usage error (nothing was sent). Upgrade every machine that manages sandboxes to this CLI. If a server still predates the move, install the previous CLI with: curl -fsSL https://axiomcore.dev/install | VERSION=0.153.0 bash Reload any dashboard tab that was open during the switch.
